prerequisites: Successful completion of the subject "Production Technologies II"
Knowledge of fundamental methods of machining

learning_outcomes.text: Students will master fundamental machining technologies based on the principles of physical and chemical interactions of the machine-workpiece-tool system.
Students will be familiar with physics and other aspects of machining.
They will be able to define technological processes for all fundamental manufacturing methods.
They will have an overview of principles applied for technological assembly.

syllabus_topics: Force analysis, heat and temperature when cutting, residual stresses and other metal cutting phenomena.
Tool materials for cutting. HSS, cemented carbides, ceramics, diamond, etc. CVD, MTCVD and PVD coatings.
Turning. Turning of outer and inner surfaces.
Milling. Face and shoulder milling, grooving, copying, special operations.
Finishing technologies. Non-conventional methods of machining.
Machine tools for automatic production. CNC machining.
Gear production. Machine tools. Rapid prototyping.
Fundamentals of technology and assembly managements.
Productivity and economics of machining (Laboratory exercise).
Grinding and other finishing methods (Laboratory exercise).
Machine tools for automatic production (Laboratory exercise).
Gear production. Non-conventional methods of machining (Laboratory exercise).

assessment_methods.method: Defence of written works, protocols or technical reports

assessment_rules: The examination consists of a written and an oral part. The written part focuses on solving a technological problem, assessing professional skills. The oral part tests knowledge of a randomly selected topic to assess depth of understanding. Successful completion also requires successful completion of two knowledge tests and successful defense of written works, protocols, or technical reports. Compulsory and checked participation in exercises and labs is required, with obligatory full presence in all exercises.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
